_comment: tiny-chat E1 at 20M, the shape sweep (experiments/tiny_chat_2026-10/PREREGISTRATION.md). 12 pretraining runs of 10000 steps x 16384 tokens (163.84M), each then SFT (1500 steps on human dialogues), two fixed text panels and Carry-5 (post job); one pick per cell. learning rates from stage0/lr_choice.json: 20m_L16 0.001, 20m_L2 0.001, 20m_L32 0.002, 20m_L4 0.001. One GPU job at a time (amendment 2: Stage 0 measured no throughput gain from sharing the L4, and sharing crashed its screens); rung jobs beside it in the light slot, their cache capped at 2048 MB. Estimated 30 L4 VM-hours (the Stage 0 probes, plus 0.3 h per post job and 0.08 h per rung, unmeasured). Rungs (amendment 1): every PT job snapshots its weights at steps [500, 1000, 2500, 5000] and a light rung job scores each snapshot (panels, base-model Carry-5 teacher-forced; rung.json home); runs are never stopped early. Home: each PT job's weights (relays + final), each post's summary.json, each rung's rung.json, each pick's best model. Upload vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf with the runner's --upload. Amendment 3: the gate refuses unless the floor pilot PASSED (pilot/verdict.json). Carry-5 generation (24 Oct 2026, PREREGISTRATION.md implementation note): ember.cpp's CUDA server at 69d7ca26d5cd (cloned and built once per VM by the first post job, under a lock), on the SFT model's F32 GGUF; every post job first generates 40 fixed items with ember and with mtstudio chat and lets ember generate only on 40/40 identical replies, else mtstudio for the whole run (gen_flag in its summary.json). Forced-choice scoring stays with mtstudio score. Dialogue levels [0, 17, 35, 70]% (copies), E1 at 35% (design.json final).
